invention.ref: Soap-like materials made in ancient Babylon
invention.ref_zh: 古巴比伦已制作类似肥皂的物质

notes: 古巴比伦的是「类肥皂」物质，真正的肥皂工艺大约在其后到公元 1 世纪之间形成，因此只标到世纪。
summary_zh: 约公元前 2800 年的古巴比伦已有制作类似肥皂物质的证据；古罗马人至迟在公元 1 世纪才开始用肥皂。
summary_en: Evidence of soap-like materials dates to ancient Babylon around 2800 BCE; the Romans did not use soap until at least the 1st century CE.
notes_en: The Babylonian material was soap-like; true soap-making emerged sometime between then and the 1st century CE, so only century precision is used.
